blocks.text: NEW ORLEAN — Nikola Jokic had 21 points, 13 rebounds and 10 assists for his 200th career triple-double in the NBA regular season, and the Denver Nuggets never trailed in a 104-91 victory over the winless New Orleans Pelicans on Wednesday night. Jamal Murray scored 23 points, and Aaron Gordon added 15 points and 11 rebounds for the Nuggets, who swept a two-game, home-and-home series with New Orleans.
